prompt: Create a seamless, tileable square material texture for a production website background. A nearly black midnight navy jacquard cloth dyed #0d1830, viewed straight-on with flat even illumination. Extremely subtle fine woven warp-and-weft threads, restrained irregular fiber variation, almost no contrast, no folds, no seams, no vignette, no objects, no symbols, no ornament, no text, no border. The texture should disappear behind readable cream typography while preventing a flat digital fill. Uniform edge-to-edge and suitable for CSS background-repeat at small scale.
